notes.title: Jeziorne - Kolonia Demo update
notes.notes:
We're changing for you

We've just pushed out a patch to the demo with fixes you've brought to our attention. Some of the major things this patch addresses are:

top-down section (kayak rental) related bugs fixes,

TPP walk speed increased,

added Credits,

added missing sound effects,

removed a couple pickup items,

fixed a couple soft locks and edge-case crashes,

and many more!

We’re working hard on addressing complaints about camera (testings two new modes), melee combat and inventory management.

More languages
We've added language support (dialogues and UI) for the following:

Simplified Chinese,

French,

German,

Japanese.


We’ll also add these languages by the end of next week:

Portuguese,

Brazilian Portuguese,

Russian,

Spanish,

Latin America Spanish,

Turkish,

Ukrainian.

Thank you!!!
A big thank you to everyone who has played the demo so far! The reception has been incredible, and we're sitting at overwhelmingly positive 96% on Steam with it. 

If you think that what we're creating here is something special, please share our demo with any friends or online communities you are part of. It helps us immensely. We've always believed that putting a game into the hands of players to get feedback and also have the game speak for itself is the best thing any indie game dev can do so the more we get onboard, the higher we can go with this pixel abomination of ours.

With love,
Sonka

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43338400/ce95c48d5882df8fe1fea2d8829cb923a568d252.png"]

notes.title: Major Demo Update For Steam Scream Fest
notes.notes:
Over the last few weeks, we've been making some changes to the game and demo, a lot of which is thanks to your feedback.

So in tandem with The Steam Scream Fest, we've just released an update to the demo. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43338400/8b8154825a28b44731e285d2cf133f4d534c6e1c.gif

Patch Notes
New Languages

 Chinese (Simplified)
 Finnish
 French
 German
 Japanese
 Portuguese
 Portuguese (Brazil)
 Ukrainian
 Russian
 Spanish
 Spanich (Latin America)
 TurkishStamina rework
While we're still working on stamina implementation, in the current version aiming does not drain stamina.

Steam Deck Support
Multiple performance and UI tweaks for a better Steam Deck experience.

Gameplay Changes
 Aim assist is now off by default
 Herbs restore 40 stamina now
 Stomp no longer damages if dodged into
 Improved enemy pathfinding
Performance
 Automatic performance improvement in case of low fps
 Multiple performance improvements
Fixes
 sometimes mouse pointer would stay visible in TPP mode
 multiple inventory items could be sharing the same slot if certain requirements are met
 QTE animation glitches fixed
 stomp animation issues
 UI glitches when quickly changing windows
 problems when returning from menu while aiming
 spikes area damage
 issues with ooze near doors
 toilet seat glitches
 issues with dragging sliders and closing windows
 collider issues on Broken Rack
 quick slots UI sometimes showed a wrong item when dragging it across quick slots
